summary: First QA pass on TopPass5 vault. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passed covering health, auth staged flow (login -> birthday -> complete), admin seed login with admin@example.com + 1990-01-01, items CRUD + reveal + favorite, share link (create/consume/invalid rejection), import, bulk-delete, advance-mode create/reveal/wrong-passphrase/share-blocked/delete-with-x-advance-passphrase, hardcore settings get + validation + wrong-password reject, layer3 passwords (20 entries), security report, preferences, audit, VIP status, encryption roundtrip verified. Frontend: landing/loading screen renders, Get Started -> login form reached, admin login + birthday verify stage succeeds and vault dashboard loads with user email + add-value button + sidebar nav. 3-layer auth staging works end-to-end.

minor.issue: admin_stats() handler is defined (server.py line 877) but has NO @router decorator, so the admin stats endpoint is not exposed over HTTP. Admin panel UI calling GET /api/admin/stats will 404.

issues: Greeting heading 'Good to see you, <name>' wraps vertically and overlaps the action button row ('Quick actions / Import / CSV / Export / Generator / Add value'). At 1280px width the top-actions row visually collides with the h1 — tighten the topbar flex layout or allow actions to wrap to a new row.

action_items: Add @router.get('/admin/stats') decorator to admin_stats() in /app/backend/server.py (line 877). Without it, the admin dashboard metrics cards will fail to load.
Fix topbar layout collision between greeting heading and top-actions row at ~1280px (vault dashboard).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1150 lines in a single file. Consider splitting into routers (auth, items, vip, emergency, admin).
/api/admin/stats route missing decorator — dead code path.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env combined with the special-case in server.py disables credentialed cookies for wildcard origin — fine for dev, but production must set an explicit origin.

pytest.ini forces -n 2 xdist loadscope; tests share a single backend/preview env, so stateful tests (login lockouts, hardcore account deletion) could race across workers if expanded later — document the constraint.

requests.Session cookie jar leaks across tests (initial test_items_requires_auth returned 200 due to a prior admin login's access_token cookie). Needed a fresh client to assert unauth 401 — flagged and fixed.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / AdminPass123! / 1990-01-01 (seeded on startup via backend/.env ADMIN_* vars)
seed_data_creation: None persisted intentionally. Tests create TEST_-prefixed items and random test_<uuid>@test.com users; items are cleaned up where feasible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist (configured in /app/backend/pytest.ini with -n 2 --dist loadscope). BASE_URL falls back to reading /app/frontend/.env if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var isn't exported. Admin flow verified: POST /api/auth/login returns {stage:'birthday', token: <staged>}, then POST /api/auth/verify-birthday with Bearer <staged> + {birthday:'1990-01-01'} returns {stage:'complete', token}. Advance item deletion requires HTTP header 'x-advance-passphrase: <phrase>' (NOT a request body field). Share endpoint is POST /api/items/{id}/share, consume via GET /api/share/{token}. /api/admin/stats is MISSING route decorator so admin panel will 404 against it.
rca of the issue: admin stats 404 root cause: handler `async def admin_stats(...)` at server.py L877 is a plain async function — no @router.get / @app.get decorator — so FastAPI never registers the path. Fix: prepend `@router.get('/admin/stats')` on the line above the function signature.
